mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, task_id, group_execution_id, pull_call_id, pull_wave_id, participant_type, participant_ref_id, target_phone, target_jid, puller_group_account_id, puller_assignment_seq, attempt_no, failure_count_before, lifecycle_status, active_slot, protocol_outcome, execution_state, reason_code, reason_message, submitted_at, result_at, released_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt ( task_id, group_execution_id, pull_call_id, pull_wave_id, participant_type, participant_ref_id, target_phone, target_jid, puller_group_account_id, puller_assignment_seq, attempt_no, failure_count_before, lifecycle_status, active_slot, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{groupExecutionId}, #{pullCallId}, #{pullWaveId}, #{participantType}, #{participantRefId}, #{targetPhone}, #{targetJid}, #{pullerGroupAccountId}, #{pullerAssignmentSeq}, #{attemptNo}, #{failureCountBefore}, #{lifecycleStatus}, #{activeSlot}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt WHERE pull_call_id = #{pullCallId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt SET lifecycle_status = #{transition.target.lifecycleStatus}, active_slot = #{transition.target.activeSlot}, protocol_outcome = #{transition.target.protocolOutcome}, execution_state = #{transition.target.executionState}, reason_code = #{transition.result.reasonCode}, reason_message = #{transition.result.reasonMessage}, target_jid = COALESCE(#{transition.result.resultJid}, target_jid), result_at = #{transition.result.occurredAt}, released_at = #{transition.target.releasedAt}, updated_at = #{transition.scope.now} WHERE id = #{transition.scope.attemptId} AND lifecycle_status IN #{status}
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_row.participant_type, attempt_row.participant_ref_id, attempt_row.target_phone, attempt_row.target_jid, CASE WHEN attempt_row.participant_type = 1 THEN material_row.pull_failure_count ELSE station_row.membership_failure_count END AS failure_count FROM pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt attempt_row LEFT JOIN pull_task_material_member material_row ON attempt_row.participant_type = 1 AND material_row.id = attempt_row.participant_ref_id AND material_row.group_execution_id = attempt_row.group_execution_id LEFT JOIN pull_task_group_account station_row ON attempt_row.participant_type = 2 AND station_row.id = attempt_row.participant_ref_id AND station_row.group_execution_id = attempt_row.group_execution_id WHERE attempt_row.pull_wave_id = #{pullWaveId} AND CASE WHEN attempt_row.participant_type = 1 THEN material_row.pull_failure_count ELSE station_row.membership_failure_count END < #{maxFailureCount} AND ((attempt_row.participant_type = 1 AND material_row.pull_status <> 2) OR (attempt_row.participant_type = 2 AND station_row.membership_status <> 2)) AND ((attempt_row.lifecycle_status = 3 AND attempt_row.protocol_outcome = 'FAILED') OR (attempt_row.lifecycle_status = 4 AND attempt_row.protocol_outcome = 'UNKNOWN' AND attempt_row.execution_state = 'NOT_STARTED') OR (attempt_row.lifecycle_status = 4 AND attempt_row.protocol_outcome = 'UNKNOWN' AND attempt_row.execution_state = 'UNCERTAIN' AND attempt_row.reason_code = 'ROSTER_NOT_PRESENT')) ORDER BY attempt_row.participant_type ASC, attempt_row.participant_ref_id ASC, attempt_row.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt SET puller_group_account_id = #{binding.target.pullerGroupAccountId}, puller_assignment_seq = #{binding.target.assignmentSeq}, updated_at = #{binding.now} WHERE pull_call_id = #{binding.scope.pullCallId} AND lifecycle_status = 1 AND ((#{binding.scope.expectedPullerGroupAccountId} IS NULL AND puller_group_account_id IS NULL) OR puller_group_account_id = #{binding.scope.expectedPullerGroupAccountId}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_pull_call call_row WHERE call_row.id = pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt.pull_call_id AND call_row.call_status = #{binding.scope.expectedCallStatus} )

UPDATE pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt SET lifecycle_status = #{targetStatus}, active_slot = NULL, execution_state = #{executionState}, reason_code = #{reasonCode}, reason_message = #{reasonMessage}, result_at = #{now}, released_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND lifecycle_status = #{expectedStatus} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_pull_call call_row WHERE call_row.id = pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt.pull_call_id AND call_row.call_status = #{plannedCallStatus} )

UPDATE pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt SET lifecycle_status = #{targetStatus}, active_slot = NULL, execution_state = #{executionState}, reason_code = #{reasonCode}, reason_message = #{reasonMessage}, result_at = #{now}, released_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE group_execution_id = #{groupExecutionId} AND lifecycle_status = #{expectedStatus} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pull_task_pull_call call_row WHERE call_row.id = pull_task_pull_call_member_attempt.pull_call_id AND call_row.call_status = #{plannedCallStatus} )
